title: String Algorithms

views.title: String Algorithms
views.intro: KMP and the Z-function give linear pattern matching and expose periodic structure; Rabin-Karp hashes windows (use two moduli and verify); Manacher finds the longest palindrome in O(n). The rest are careful big-number and parsing routines.
table: Pattern search, repeated pattern, shortest palindrome
Rolling hash, duplicate substring with binary search

files.desc: Prefix function, KMP, repeated pattern, shortest palindrome, Z, Rabin-Karp, Manacher, anagram, isomorphic, compress, reverse words, multiply, add, atoi, roman

pitfalls: KMP failure function: on mismatch fall back with k = pi[k - 1], never reset to 0.
Rabin-Karp: single mod hashes collide on adversarial inputs; use two moduli and verify with startsWith.
atoi: clamp as you accumulate, using long, before overflow.

views.title: Strings: Suffix & Multi-Pattern
views.intro: Beyond KMP and Z: suffix arrays answer substring-counting questions, Aho-Corasick matches many patterns at once, and a handful of parsing questions test careful state handling.

files.desc: Suffix array, Kasai LCP, distinct substrings, longest repeated / duplicate substring, Aho-Corasick, word break II, palindrome pairs, longest happy prefix, least rotation, text justification, valid number, encode / decode strings, compare version numbers, zigzag conversion

pitfalls: Suffix array: sort by doubling ranks, then Kasai builds LCP in O(n).
Aho-Corasick needs fail links built by BFS, and output links to report all matches.
Parsing problems: write the state machine on paper first; flags beat regex.

decisions.q: Does the string repeat a smaller unit?

decisions.a: Single pass with long accumulator and clamping

decisions.q: Longest prefix that is also a suffix?

decisions.a: Hash all words, split each word at every index

calibration: SDE2 bar: anagram checks, longest common prefix, reverse words, string compression, atoi, add/multiply strings.
SDE3 bar: KMP or rolling hash for substring search, repeated substring pattern, shortest palindrome, Z-function ideas.
Staff bar (for context): Manacher, suffix arrays or automata at a conceptual level, hash collision analysis, and streaming string matching.
Staff bar: know suffix array + LCP and Aho-Corasick well enough to write them, and be able to say why a trie of patterns alone is not enough.
